<translate>
<!--T:4-->
The '''Grand Kai''' stands in the cloud realm of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld|Otherworld]], next to [[Special:MyLanguage/King Yemma|King Yemma]]. He teaches no skills: he has story dialogue and sends you to the grounds of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:5-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:6-->
The Grand Kai is in the Otherworld's main cloud deck, near the spirit arrival point, King Yemma, [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hell Ogre|Hell Ogre]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Tournament == <!--T:7-->
</translate>
{{Main|Otherworld Tournament}}
<translate>
<!--T:8-->
* His '''Tournament''' option teleports you to the Otherworld Tournament grounds, on the upper cloud deck. The '''[[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament Announcer|Otherworld Tournament Announcer]]''' there hosts the tournament and can send you back to the Grand Kai.
* The grounds are built automatically the first time the server runs with the Otherworld enabled. Until they're finished, the Grand Kai tells you how far along they are.
</translate>
